normalization_plan.reason: Sweep address array only exists to drive the transferOutBlacklistedFunds loop, so it can be folded into that core function node.
Transient admin argument is immediately written to the admin state variable by setLosslessAdmin.
Candidate value is stored directly into recoveryAdminCanditate by this core function.
Key hash is stored into recoveryAdminKeyHash inside this function only.
Key preimage is only meaningful inside the hashing check of this function.

Amount is forwarded to the lossless hook and _transfer called by transfer.

Amount is only used inside approve's hook and _approve call.
